implementation.targetScope: Flat-source headless data tables: accessors, cached row/cell models, sorting, column/global filtering, facets, grouping/aggregation/expansion, pagination, row selection, visibility/order/pinning and static sizing. Current Table9 construction/state API and the Table8 runtime adapter contract used by Material React Table3.2.1. Nested source rows/headers, interactive resizing, cell selection/spanning, arbitrary feature plugins and framework adapters are outside scope.

changes: Independent indexed pipeline with stage caches and one VPM Store dependency; no upstream table runtime ships.
Duplicate input row and column IDs fail explicitly instead of silently overwriting indexed entries.
Null-prototype value/index records and own-property selection checks preserve prototype-like row IDs.
Current and installed-app APIs have distinct compatibility paths for header pinning and aggregation flags.
Presentation-only column changes and equivalent row-ID/child wrappers retain the data model, avoiding pagination resets while preserving validation and real data/accessor invalidation.
Custom sorting callbacks run for grouped rows with absent aggregate values; explicit first/last placement remains stable.

Page selection and deselection visit collapsed group descendants, honor per-row selection policies, and preserve selections on other pages; separate Table8/Table9 header flag contracts are compared against both controls.

caller.name: material-react-table
caller.scope: Flat resource and contest-season tables through the shared DataTable wrapper, including collapsed grouping and copy-selected actions. Package publication does not establish application adoption.
